theme_reasoning: A dark theme with deep obsidian and subtle gold/sand accents communicates 'Quiet Luxury', trust, and exclusivity perfectly suited for high-net-worth wealth management.

headings.instruction: Use for all H1, H2, and H3. Embrace the editorial feel. Never use generic sans-serif for headings.

body.instruction: Use for all paragraphs, labels, and small text. Highly readable at smaller sizes.

hierarchy.overline: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-sans font-medium text-[#D4AF37]

colors.instruction: Do not use pure black. Use #0A0A0A. Accent with #D4AF37 (Gold) very sparingly for buttons, active states, and overlines.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Crystal Glass' for the sticky header: bg-[#0A0A0A]/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10. For cards, use flat #121212 with a 1px border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and their borders glow subtly (border-white/20). Links must transition opacity.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion for smooth, staggered fade-up reveals on scroll. No bouncy or excessive animations. Everything must feel slow, deliberate, and expensive.
visual_enhancers.noise: Add a very subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the viewport to kill 'digital flatness' and make it feel like premium print.

layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. Sections should have py-24 to py-32. Elements should have gap-12 to gap-16.
layouts.hero: Immersive dark overlay (bg-black/50) over the hero image. Left-aligned typography. H1 extremely large serif, accompanied by a refined 'Book Consultation' pill-shaped button.
layouts.about: Asymmetrical split: Portrait image on the right (slightly offset), sophisticated typography on the left.
layouts.services: Bento Grid Strategy. 1 tall column, 2 stacked columns. Generous padding inside cards (p-10).
layouts.booking: Clean, distraction-free section. Left side: value proposition. Right side: Shadcn Calendar + form.
layouts.dashboard: Minimalist sidebar + dense data grid. Use Shadcn components heavily here. Sharp edges, utilitarian but elegant.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#E6D5B8]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 rounded-none focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-[#D4AF37].
components.chatbot: Floating glass orb at bottom right (bg-[#1A1A1A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10). Expands into a sleek chat window. No robotic emojis.
components.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism header. Minimal links. Right-aligned CTA.
components.footer: Massive py-32. Must clearly display 'SEBI/AMFI Registered Mutual Fund Distributor' and 'ARN-349743'. Include contact: 9740542188 | satvikkinvestments@gmail.com.

hero_background.description: Glass walled luxury modern office. Use as hero background with heavy black/dark gradient overlay.

satvik_portrait.description: Professional Indian business man portrait on dark background. Use for the 'About Satvik' section.

booking_background.description: High end luxury interior desk. Use as a subtle background behind the booking section with high opacity overlay.

service_accent.description: Abstract gold dark background texture. Use inside service cards as subtle hover reveals or background accents.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient text-shadow or a dark overlay. Accent gold must pass contrast on #0A0A0A.

testing.attributes: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='book-consultation-btn', data-testid='chatbot-toggle').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Dark colors look good when used independently.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry and generous spacing (p-20, p-32).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with hover states.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters. Use elegant SVG icons.
DO NOT use a completely transparent header. Use crystal glassmorphism.
MUST display ARN-349743 and contact details prominently in the footer.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all functional elements.
